summary: Some signs of overfitting: read the findings.

findings.title: Generalisation gap
findings.explanation: The model scores clearly higher on rows it trained on than on the test: some memorisation.

findings.title: Calib vs test
findings.explanation: Test is clearly higher than calib: the two splits are not alike.

findings.title: Train/test overlap
findings.explanation: Some test inputs also appear, exactly or nearly, in the training rows.

examples.test: How much does it cost to top up by card?
examples.train: How much does it cost to top up by transfer?

examples.test: Can you tell me why my top up was reverted?
examples.train: Can you tell me why my top-up was canceled?

examples.test: Can I create a disposable virtual card?
examples.train: How can I create a disposable virtual card?

findings.title: Selection pressure
findings.explanation: 2 experiments were compared on calib; the winner leads by more than chance would give.

findings.title: Learning curve
findings.explanation: Dev levelled off before training ended, with no late drop.
